note: The most recent full pass whose billed block was archived with its population and its capability census. This is the reference the dispatch projection scales; it is refreshed by `--refresh-spend-baseline <artifact>` when a newer full pass exists.

capabilityRates.note: Capabilities whose question-run price has been BILLED rather than derived from the file average. A capability-scoped dispatch is otherwise priced as a floor: the census says how many questions it asks and nothing about what they cost, and the file average is not what a route costs. Absent capabilities are absent on purpose -- the floor and its LOWER BOUND label stay until a bill covers them, because inventing a rate from the file average is the 3.4x error section 13.348 measured.

MR.source: PREREGISTRATION-CORTEX-MEMORY-ARM.md section 13.348.2: `capability=MR` at two repetitions billed 5.87 CNY against a 1.73 projection. The rate is billedCny / (billedQuestions x billedRuns) = 0.0243, computed at read time and never stored rounded.
MR.armConfig: the arm shipped on the day of that dispatch: deepseek-chat, thinking on multi-session+temporal, both sides and the judge included in the bill
MR.caveat: The bill bundles both arms and the judge, so the rate is a whole-dispatch price rather than a reader-call price. It is linear in repetitions and stated per question-run; it is not comparable to `costPerCapability`'s feature-side rows for the same capability, which apportion completion by question-runs and therefore understate a thinking route.
